errors.text_span: Осата Y представлява стойностите на БВП на човек от населението в EUR
errors.evidence: The description states that the Y-axis represents the values of GDP per capita in EUR. While this is the meaning of the data according to the caption, the Y-axis itself has no label. The description hallucinates a label that is not present on the chart axis.

The description states the line starts at a value of around 19,000 in 2012. Visually, the line starts significantly lower, closer to 18,000, which is well below the midpoint between 15,000 and 20,000.
